description: Source code implementing the Buffer11 class and related buffer storage classes for Direct3D 11 rendering in ANGLE, including buffer management, mapping, copying, and resource views.

classes.name: Buffer11
classes.description: Main class managing D3D11 buffers and their storage variants.

classes.name: Buffer11::BufferStorage
classes.description: Abstract base class for different buffer storage types.

classes.name: Buffer11::NativeStorage
classes.description: Represents a native D3D11 buffer resource.

classes.name: Buffer11::EmulatedIndexedStorage
classes.description: Emulates indexed buffers for specific rendering cases.

classes.name: Buffer11::PackStorage
classes.description: Handles CPU memory for pack buffers and asynchronous readback.

classes.name: Buffer11::SystemMemoryStorage
classes.description: Stores buffer data in CPU memory for dynamic updates.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data, possibly resizing or using system memory.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves buffer data from system memory storage.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a portion of the buffer with new data.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer, handling resource recreation if needed.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps buffer memory for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps buffer memory after CPU access.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the underlying D3D11 buffer resource.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer, preserving data if specified.

methods.name: copyFromStorage
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer storage, recreating resources if necessary.

methods.name: getSRVForFormat
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a shader resource view for a specific format.

methods.name: getRawUAV
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an unordered access view for raw buffer access.

methods.name: clearSRVs
methods.description: Clears stored shader resource views.

methods.name: clearUAVs
methods.description: Clears stored unordered access views.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Returns the native D3D11 buffer object.

methods.name: getBufferStorage
methods.description: Retrieves or creates buffer storage of a specific usage type.

methods.name: allocateStorage
methods.description: Allocates a new buffer storage based on usage.

methods.name: getConstantBufferRange
methods.description: Retrieves a constant buffer range with offset and size.

methods.name: markRawBufferUsage
methods.description: Marks the buffer as raw UAV usage.

methods.name: getRawUAVRange
methods.description: Retrieves a raw UAV for a specified range.

methods.name: getSRV
methods.description: Retrieves a shader resource view for a specific format.

methods.name: packPixels
methods.description: Performs pixel packing operations, including asynchronous readback.

methods.name: getTotalCPUBufferMemoryBytes
methods.description: Calculates total CPU memory used by buffer storages.

methods.name: getBufferStorage
methods.description: Template method to get or create buffer storage of a specific type.

methods.name: updateBufferStorage
methods.description: Updates buffer storage with latest data, handling resource recreation.

methods.name: getLatestBufferStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent buffer storage.

methods.name: getStagingStorage
methods.description: Template method to get or create staging buffer storage.

methods.name: initializeStaticData
methods.description: Initializes static buffer data.

methods.name: invalidateStaticData
methods.description: Invalidates static buffer data.

methods.name: onCopyStorage
methods.description: Updates data revision after copying storage.

methods.name: onStorageUpdate
methods.description: Marks storage as updated and refreshes latest buffer reference.
